title: Concept: Search index name exposed in results
description: An index name that carries the data class and the date in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The name tells the attacker which index holds the customer records and how the data is partitioned by time, which is the targeting detail for a scroll attack.
applicability: Deployments that render an index name that carries the data class and the date into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The name tells the attacker which index holds the customer records and how the data is partitioned by time, which is the targeting detail for a scroll attack.
